reasons: The way you narrate your day like it's a movie I'm starring in.
You save the best part of your day to tell me last.
You pick up on my mood from a single emoji.
Your little "reached home?" check every single night.
You make ordinary Tuesdays feel like something to look forward to.
The way your eyes light up when you talk about your dreams.
You never make me compete with your phone, because I am the phone.
You laugh at my jokes even when the network ruins the punchline.
You send me photos of the sky so we can share the same view.
You remember the names of all my friends, even the ones you've never seen.
You fall asleep mid-sentence and still say goodnight in the morning.
You make me feel chosen, not just loved.
The way you defend me when I'm not around.
You turn our time-zone math into a game.
You always ask how I am, and actually wait for the answer.
You hum when you think nobody is listening. I'm always listening.
You made a screen feel warmer than most rooms.
You never once made me doubt us.
Your handwriting in the photos of notes you send me.
You know exactly when I need space and exactly when I don't.
You make me braver about the things I'm scared of.
Your goofy faces on video calls when the camera freezes.
You treat my small wins like headline news.
You say sorry first, even when it wasn't all your fault.
You make me believe distance is just a number on a map.
Your excitement over food is honestly adorable.
You keep every promise, even the tiny ones.
You taught me what it feels like to be understood.
You make silence on a call feel comfortable, not empty.
Your random "I miss you" in the middle of the afternoon.
You're the most beautiful person I've never stood next to. Yet.
You make me laugh on days I didn't think I could.
You're gentle with my heart and fierce about my happiness.
Your curiosity about everything, especially about me.
You make our future sound so real I can almost touch it.
You light up when someone you love does well.
You are my favourite person to do nothing with.
You never let a fight end without "I love you".
The way you say "okay, last five minutes" and stay for an hour.
You make me feel safe from hundreds of kilometres away.
You remember every one of our little anniversaries.
You're strong, and soft, and somehow both at once.
You notice when I change my profile picture within minutes.
You make me want to build a whole life, not just a relationship.
Your love feels steady, like a light that never flickers.
You turned "someday" into a plan.
You make me proud to call you mine.
Every conversation with you feels like coming home.
You made me fall in love without ever holding my hand.
Because one year with you already feels like forever, and I want more.
